name: Bamboo sticky rice
summary: Cơm lam is glutinous rice cooked in a bamboo tube. Vietnam Airlines says it smells of forest bamboo and is soft and rich. VnExpress adds upland rice, banana leaf, a wood fire, and sesame salt. The price is Check on arrival.
origin: Vietnam Airlines travel guide, and VnExpress, Xuân Mạnh, 3 Jul 2023.
texture: Vietnam Airlines says the rice is soft and rich. VnExpress says the tube picks up smoke from the wood fire.
howToEat: From the tube. VnExpress says a little sesame salt completes it, or eat it with grilled dishes and forest greens.
Vietnam Airlines says visitors can learn to cook it with Thai hosts. VnExpress says some homestays and resorts run a cooking session. A house name was not printed.
The hour is Check on arrival.
where: A Thai house in the valley. A door was not printed.
seoTitle: Com lam in Pu Luong — sticky rice in a bamboo tube
seoDescription: Cơm lam is upland sticky rice cooked in bamboo. Dip it in sesame salt or eat it with the grill. The price is Check on arrival.
